title: Clearer entrate di cassa, Altobelli tab picker, corrected reports, notebook photos
subtitle: GASS 2.30.0 — mockup design/mockups/cassa-quaderno.html
context:
Request (2026-10-14), after the 13/10 consegna:

1. The turnista did not understand that the 32,80 € given back by Altobelli could be entered as an *entra* in "Uscite di cassa". The save error said an *uscita* was missing its motivo, and the close summary still says "Uscite di cassa" for an entrata.
2. The desktop Altobelli page must say it is experimental and let an admin pick which tab of Leonardo's sheet belongs to a consegna (default: the tab with the same date). The 13/10 orders were written in the "6 ottobre" tab.
3. When a consegna is reopened and closed again, the report must highlight what changed since the previous report (today it only adds "(corretto)" to the title).
4. At close, attach one or more photos of the paper notebook where the turnisti do the accounts (a counter-check).

What exists: uscite rows in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js` (`usciteRowHtml`, badge esce/entra, sign = stored sign), validation in `server/services/validation.js`, report in `server/services/report.js` (`consegne.report_telegram/report_email` hold the last plain-text body), Altobelli in `server/services/altobelli.js` (`trovaSchede` by date, `{ scelte }` when several match), receipt photos in `server/services/scontrini.js` (files under `/app/data/scontrini/<consegna_id>/`, `scontrini.partecipante_id NOT NULL`).

Mockup: `design/mockups/cassa-quaderno.html` (sections A–D = pages A–D here). App strings stay Italian; the plan is in English because fluidplan supports en/fr only. Every UI change ships on mobile **and** desktop (project rule), except the Altobelli page, which is desktop-only.

phases.title: Altobelli: experimental label and tab picker

glossary.definition: A row of `uscite_cassa`: cash taken out of (stored positive) or put back into (stored negative) the consegna's cassa, with a motivo.
An uscita with a negative amount: money put back into the cassa, e.g. the 32,80 € Altobelli returned on 13/10.
Here: a value that changed between the report sent at the first close and the one sent after a reopen and reclose.
The numeric id of one tab of a Google sheet; GASS downloads a tab as CSV by its gid, hidden tabs included.
A JSON copy of the numbers a report showed, stored when the report is sent, so the next report can be compared field by field.

decisions.title: How the direction (out / in) is chosen
decisions.why: This is what failed on 13/10: the direction is a small badge that reads like a label, defaulting to esce. If the new control is still easy to miss, the next entrata goes in as an uscita and the cassa is off by twice the amount.

decisions.learn_more: Storage does not change: esce stays positive, entra negative in `uscite_cassa`, so pages cached before 2.28.0 and the report keep working. The empty row shown on a consegna with no uscite goes away: the two links are the empty state.

decisions.title: How GASS knows what changed
decisions.why: This decides the stored data. A text diff of the old message cannot tell which person in a line changed; a structured copy can, but adds a column whose shape must stay readable by later versions.
decisions.proposal: When a report is sent, store a **JSON snapshot** of what it showed in `consegne.report_dati`: per person {conto, versato, teatro}, the uscite rows, trovato, pagato, lasciato, sent time. The next report compares the current data with it.
decisions.learn_more: One snapshot for both channels (they are sent at the same close). Consegne closed before 2.30.0 have no snapshot: their first reclose falls back to today's behaviour (full report with "(corretto)", no rettifiche block).

options.label: JSON snapshot column
pros: Per-person, per-field changes with old values
cons: One more column and a compare function

options.label: Line diff of the stored text
pros: No schema change: the text is already stored
cons: Changes only at line level; wording changes (A2) look like rettifiche

tasks.title: Store and compare the report snapshot
tasks.do: `database.js`: `tryAddColumn('consegne', 'report_dati', 'TEXT')`. `report.js`: `reportDati(db, id)` builds the snapshot, `rettifiche(prima, ora)` returns Italian lines (C3), `notifyClosed` writes `report_dati` after a successful send.
acceptance: After a close, `report_dati` holds valid JSON
A consegna with no snapshot recloses as today

decisions.title: What counts as a rettifica
decisions.why: Too little and a correction goes unnoticed; too much and the block repeats the whole report.
decisions.proposal: Lines for: a person added or removed; per person **conto produttore**, **versato** and **quota teatro** ("Marco B: conto produttore 0 → 23,50"); tolti/rimessi rows added, removed or changed; **trovato**, **pagato al produttore** and **lasciato in cassa** when they change. Not listed: credit/debt splits (they follow from conto and versato) and the day's note.

decisions.title: Unsaved fields survive a page reload, across the app
decisions.why: On 13/10 a turnista lost a half-filled card when the page reloaded after taking a receipt photo. Any form can be lost the same way (camera, phone call, the phone dropping a background tab), so one shared mechanism is cheaper than fixing each form when it bites.
decisions.proposal: One shared helper, **`public/js/shared/bozze.js`**: every form keeps what is typed in `sessionStorage` while it is not saved, and a page that loads again puts it back with a toast "Ho ripreso quello che avevi scritto e non era salvato". Saving or cancelling the form clears it. Password fields are never stored. Applies to: the consegna card (mobile and desktop, reopened on the same person), note and tolti/rimessi, Saldi "Modifica saldo" and "Modifica utente" / new participant (desktop), the teatro corrections, the turni notes, the Altobelli link.
decisions.learn_more: `sessionStorage` belongs to the browser tab: it survives a reload or the phone dropping the page, and is gone when the tab is closed, so nothing lingers on a shared phone. Static forms are marked `data-bozza="<key>"` and handled by the helper alone; the consegna card is rendered on demand, so `consegna-common.js` reopens the card of the stored person first and then lets the helper fill it. A draft is tied to its page and date (`consegna:2026-10-20:<id>`): a draft for another date is ignored and dropped. Why the page reloaded on 13/10 is not settled by the evidence (our code never reloads after an upload; one report, no logs); a test on an Android phone would show it, and the drafts protect the form either way.

options.label: Keep unsaved fields in every form and restore them
pros: Nothing typed is lost, whatever the cause of the reload
cons: Every form needs its key and a clear-on-save call

options.label: Save the card automatically before opening the camera
cons: Saves half-typed amounts
Fails if the card is not valid yet

options.label: Not in this release
cons: Same problem next Tuesday
